name: hermes-dashboard
description: Hermes Desk(미미르 대시보드) + Hermes Office(3D 오피스) 통합 개발 폴더

scripts.check: npm --prefix office run build && cd office && npx tsx scripts/check-world.ts && npx tsx scripts/run-scenario.ts && npx tsx scripts/check-box.ts
scripts.install:desk: cd hermes-desk && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
